traces.requirement: Decode hostile unversioned JSON under inherited byte and depth ceilings.
Allocate globally fresh document, section, measure, and event IDs in structural preorder.
Create one complete 4/4 four-beat measure for each accepted legacy chord.
Apply name then root-type then notes precedence without undocumented judgment.
Match the exhaustive type map exactly and use flags only when name is absent.
Trust only 1 to 16 full scientific pitches in MIDI range with no duplicate MIDI.
Compare exact written pitch classes against one resolver realization and project slash bass explicitly.
Preserve every trusted spelling, octave, order, and legal doubling as Manual.
Convert conflicts to Custom plus Manual without plausible false theory.
Ignore UI and legacy voicing metadata as itemized evidence; never guess a voicing map.
Emit stable complete Preserved, Canonicalized, Custom, Ignored, and Rejected groups.
Cover all 80 shipped preset chords with independently authored semantic expectations.
Reject unknown or unusable nodes at exact paths without defaulting to C major.
Same bytes and deterministic ID stream produce deeply equal candidates and reports.
Return an unvalidated candidate and never publish or mutate current application state.
Terminate by deterministic work and memory counts, never elapsed wall time.
Treat hostile keys and strings as inert data and retain no caller-owned container.
Keep diagnostics code-and-path based so private musical text is not echoed.
